headline: Ukraine receives $450M in World Bank funding
summary: Ukraine has secured $450 million in World Bank financing, guaranteed by Japan. The funds are allocated for small and medium-sized business development and public investment management.
why: International financial support is essential for Ukraine's economic stability and reconstruction efforts during the ongoing conflict.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Financial aid provides critical liquidity for economic support and reconstruction.
